item.name: Spear of Borkin

ownerLore.text: Borkin was a scandalous dwarven poacher who lived between 519 - ???.

item.description: Borkin was a scandalous dwarven poacher who lived between 519 - ???. The spear is heavier than it looks, and colder than the air around it.

item.name: Short Bow of Nuggad

ownerLore.text: Nuggad was a disgraced dwarven madman who lived between 288 - 410.

item.description: Nuggad was a disgraced dwarven madman who lived between 288 - 410. The short bow has changed hands countless times. Its oldest recorded owner died more than a century ago. Whatever knowledge it holds was never meant to be understood by the living. It borrows from your strength to keep its secrets intact.

item.name: The Amphora of Fokash

ownerLore.text: Fokash was a dreaded dwarven miner who lived between 223 - 346.

item.description: Fokash was a dreaded dwarven miner who lived between 223 - 346. The amphora has changed hands countless times. Its oldest recorded owner died more than a century ago. The Amphora of Fokash killed his brother with this amphora. His brother's ghost supposedly follows whoever carries it.

item.name: Club of Svein

ownerLore.text: Svein was a cursed dwarven cave dweller who lived between 373 - 487.

item.description: Svein was a cursed dwarven cave dweller who lived between 373 - 487. The club has been repaired more times than anyone can count, yet the oldest damage remains untouched.

merchantStock.name: Rapier of Mirod

ownerLore.text: Mirod was a shady dwarven general who lived between 137 - 199.

merchantStock.description: Mirod was a shady dwarven general who lived between 137 - 199. The rapier still carries the faint scent of smoke, though no one can explain why. It was not meant to be carried alone. It no longer is.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Identification
merchantStock.description: Reveals the true name, effects and possible curse of one unidentified artifact.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Homecoming
merchantStock.description: A magical passage back to the Temple, far from the dangers of the wilderness.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Invisibility
merchantStock.description: A scroll that conceals you from ordinary sight for a limited time. True-sighted enemies may still detect you.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Fireball
merchantStock.description: Aim within 6 visible tiles. A 5×5 blast without corners deals 10–50 damage per creature, including you, ignoring armor. Walls block fire. Preview then Cast; Cancel costs nothing.

merchantStock.name: Flint Stone
merchantStock.description: Reusable fire-lighting tool. Use an abandoned campfire to light it with brushwood.

merchantStock.name: Brushwood
merchantStock.description: Dry fuel for an abandoned campfire. One bundle burns for 12 turns. Carry up to five.

merchantStock.name: Arrows
merchantStock.description: Ammunition for bows. Each shot consumes one arrow.
